verdict.comment: Plenty of the runners bring major potential. The suggestion is IPANEMA QUEEN, ahead of Fitzella and Venetian Sun.

comments.awaken: Close second to Gold Digger, pair clear, in Yarmouth contest that is working out well
comments.balantina: Made all in latest Curragh start; connections landed this prize in 2023; interesting
comments.bibidahl: US raider; promising second, albeit no match for winner, in Gulfstream Park event
comments.fairyoak: Solid second under 3lb claimer at Navan; Colin Keane takes over; could go well
comments.fitzella: Close second at Ascot, then beat Tahalel in clearcut style at Haydock; major contender
comments.golddigger: 260,000gns breeze-up buy; beat Awaken in Yarmouth race that has thrown up winners since
comments.greensense: Won at the Curragh then ran well (close second) in Naas Group 3; big player on form
comments.indigodawn: Goodwood winner who is open to progress and suitably bred (by a Royal Ascot scorer)
comments.ipanemaqueen: Scored easily in big field at the Curragh; potentially Group class; possibilities
comments.magnycours: Prevailed narrowly at Listowel; doesn't exactly look a Group filly in the making
comments.nandita: Won comfortably on Kempton AW last time; has Royal Ascot scorers in her pedigree
comments.ohcecelia: Form of her 5f Cork success has been boosted and she's by a 6f Royal Ascot winner
comments.senoritavega: Well on top at Brighton last time but faces a much stiffer task in this field
comments.signora: Clear promise in Naas Group 3; sire and dam won at Royal Ascot; brings huge potential
comments.spinninglizzie: Justified favouritism at Ripon but the runner-up did nothing for the form next time
comments.tahalel: Showed promise behind Fitzella at Haydock and looks the type to do much better
comments.venetiansun: Notable connections; form of her Carlisle win looks solid; should progress; respected

races.raceComment: senoritavega is marginally preferred with a score of 28.4%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 3 attempts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 1/3 at ascot. Key attributes include positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This could go to US challenger SHISOSPICY, who has bundles of pace and impressed when powering clear at Churchill Downs.

comments.aintnobody: Others have better form but he seems to like it here and could have an each-way shout
comments.arabiandusk: Short-headed in Group 2 Sandy Lane at Haydock and each-way chance if backing up that run
comments.arabie: French Group-race wins last summer; fair efforts the last twice but needs something extra
comments.arizonablaze: Group 3 winner at Chantilly in April but only sixth in the Sandy Lane at Haydock since
comments.babouche: 2yo Group 1 winner who impressed in Group 3 at Naas last month; she's one to consider
comments.berkshirewhisper: 3-4 prior to Listed fourth at Newbury last month; needs sizeable step forward today
comments.bigmojo: Won the Group 3 Trial over C&D; ran well in fourth in Sandy Lane since; each-way claims
comments.carlaridge: She's run well in defeat in Irish Group races the last twice but others have stronger form
comments.diablorojo: Close second in Group 3 Trial over C&D; should finish to good effect in this big field
comments.idesofmarch: 2yo Group 3 winner; Listed runner-up on both 3yo starts; further improvement needed
comments.jonquil: Went very close in French 2,000 Guineas; can play a leading role if taking to sprinting
comments.ladywiththelamp: 2-2 this season (both Listed); hasn't had much to spare but could have more left in tank
comments.leovanni: Won the Queen Mary here last June; promising Listed 4th on comeback; interesting outsider
comments.rayevka: Surge of improvement for French Listed win; remains to be seen where limitations now lie
comments.sayidahdariyan: 2l third in Listed race at Newbury last time but has something to find here
comments.shadowoflight: Outstayed when excellent 3rd in 2,000 Guineas; has the potential to be top-class sprinter
comments.shisospicy: Impressive at Churchill Downs; this exciting US challenger could take plenty of catching
comments.skymajesty: 3-3 last season (including two Group races); has to improve considerably upon comeback 3rd
comments.soldiersheart: 2yo Listed winner at Ripon last August; Listed fifth in France on return; others preferred
comments.strongwarrior: 2-2 prior to good second on handicap debut at Windsor, but has lots to find today
comments.timeforsandals: Placed in Group races on her last three starts but has to raise her game to win this
comments.whistlejacket: 2yo Group 1 winner; no match for Babouche last time but reportedly banged head on gates

races.raceComment: shadowoflight is marginally preferred with a score of 60.0%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over bigmojo. Won 2 of last 4 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 4/6 at ascot. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: Ethical Diamond is second choice behind HAND OF GOD who grabbed the 3yo handicap over 1m2f at this meeting last year.

comments.almoshher: Debut last December; he's now 3-4, last time holding Stressfree in 1m4f handicap at York
comments.auldtoonloon: Question to answer on firmer than good but his career is gathering serious momentum again
comments.bluelemons: Very hit and miss in his four hurdle races but the champion jumps trainer earns respect
comments.brodure: Progressive runs going left-handed on soft ground over 1m2f in the French provinces
comments.caviarheights: 1m2f Listed win last May last term; didn't kick on from that; 520,000gns buy over new trip
comments.ethicaldiamond: Tricky to settle but fourth in this last year off 2lb lower and same in the County Hurdle
comments.flightleader: Ran well at 33-1 when never-dangerous fourth at Chester (10.3f, good) on British debut
comments.frenchduke: C&D 6th at this meeting last year; missed prep race but he's lightly raced and progressive
comments.hmspresident: Neck 2nd in this race two years ago off the same mark as today, so not entirely dismissed
comments.handofgod: 1m2f win at this meeting on final start last term; worth another chance on second run 2025
comments.maxmayhem: Won stylishly at Meydan (1m4f, good) in March but put in his place back in Britain since
comments.mountatlas: Fifth of six in 1m5f Group 3 at Chester has earned him a 4lb rise but he needs respect
comments.mutaawid: Fair 5th at Epsom; a return to this trip is probably okay; needs to resume improvement
comments.naqeeb: Seems to be getting his act together again judged on two 1m4f handicaps this term
comments.satin: Renewed hope from two competitive displays but others still look more potent for the win
comments.seehector: Placed twice at Meydan (1m1f/1m4f) before a poor show when 40-1 at York last month
comments.siegeoftroy: Disappointing last time; tongue-tie is added and she needs overall improvement
comments.stressfree: Comes from off the pace and has been very reliable, at 1m4f recently as well as 1m2f
comments.teumessiasfox: Seems to have found his niche on the Kempton AW; cheekpieces (tried once in 2023) return
comments.warrooms: Some renewed hope; tries cheekpieces, for same connections who won this race last year

races.raceComment: stressfree is marginally preferred with a score of 54.8%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive over auldtoonloon.
